description:
HeatExchanger (components/heat_exchanger.rs:16) has area: Area -- but that is heat-TRANSFER surface area, not an envelope. A compact plate HX and a large shell-and-tube unit can share an area, so it cannot drive a faithful on-screen size on its own.

Needs a shell/footprint dimension alongside the existing area (keep the area -- it is real and used by the physics).

Part of op-dt3.17. The digital-twin widget layer must derive a component's on-screen size from its REAL dimensions; the engine crate forbids new physics, so the dimension must exist here in tampines.

DO NOT use HemSteamCv::get_volume() as a size -- it is the thermodynamic control volume, caller-supplied and unvalidated, conventionally a 1 m3 dummy (get_ref_vol() returns exactly 1.0 m3). It describes the fluid parcel, not the machine.

Prefer explicit named dimensions where shape matters to the drawing; a single nominal Volume is acceptable where only a rough size correlation is wanted. Document units and valid ranges in the doc comment per the workspace human-interface rule, and keep uom types.
title: tampines HeatExchanger: add envelope dimensions distinct from heat-transfer area

description:
op-t647 landed interfaces::checked on 2026-08-11 (commit 4feb6c84) covering 23 functions plus 2 public validators: the (T,p) single-phase family (11) and the (p,h) family (12). Deliberately left uncovered, each still panic-only:

- the (p,s) flash family
- the (h,s) flash family
- pt_flash_metastable
- the two-phase *_tp_eqm_two_phase(t,p,x) family
- alpha_v and kappa_t
- the OOP TampinesSteamTableCV surface
- the choked-flow solvers

Each has its own validity-range module, so each needs its own envelope gate rather than a shared one.

FOLLOW THE PATTERN ALREADY ESTABLISHED, which is the valuable part of op-t647: NO catch_unwind. The facade works by tracing every reachable panic in the wrapped call graph to a small number of envelope gates and excluding those cases before the internals run. That is why it is a bounds check and not an exception handler. It also caught NaN explicitly, because the internals range comparisons silently return false on NaN and would otherwise pass it straight through.

NOTE the interaction with the P1 router bug filed separately: p = 100 MPa exactly panics above 623.15 K because of a half-open range in the Region-2/Region-3 arms. Fix that first if possible, since otherwise every new gate has to encode the same exclusion as a workaround.
title: tampines-steam-tables: extend the bounds-checked facade to the remaining panicking entry points

description: Port Torus{X,Y,Z} CSG surfaces into outram-mc-libs geometry/surface.rs. Unlike the quadric surfaces (op-ah7), a torus is a QUARTIC surface, so ray-torus intersection needs a quartic root solver (Ferrari/companion-matrix) rather than the shared smallest_positive_root quadratic path. Mirror OpenMC SurfaceTorus (src/surface.cpp). Lower priority — tori are rarely used in reactor CSG.
title: outram-mc: port Torus{X,Y,Z} quartic CSG surfaces (needs quartic root solver)

description:
WAIVED by the maintainer on 2026-08-13: 'don't bother with the parity. Just do it. we will dogfood or publish whatever.'

No byte-for-byte comparison against token_usage.py / historian.py was run. Consequence recorded in crates/kovan-metrics/README.md and CLAUDE.md: the Python scripts are RETAINED, not deleted, so a comparison remains possible later if anyone wants one.

What stands in its place: 37 unit tests (trailer round-trip, transcript slug, numstat rename-compaction, leap years, and the honesty rules -- source=none renders as no-data never as 0), plus hand-verification against real history: 'kovan tokens query' read 285 commits on origin/develop, 'kovan historian' rendered a 110-commit window, and commit b3c5835c carries a live trailer stamped by the Rust hook (total=121773353 source=session-transcript).

Note the Rust is NOT merely equivalent to the Python here -- it is better on Windows. The Python's transcript-directory slug collapsed runs of non-alphanumerics and so never matched the real directory on this host, reading zero tokens where the Rust reads 721 records / 114M. A strict parity gate would have been wrong to demand byte-identical behaviour.
title: Parity tests: Rust output vs Python output

description:
outram-mc-libs::material::thermal::ThermalScattering only has from_endf_file, so every thermal-scattering test needs a multi-MB tsl-*.endf at a hardcoded absolute path that is absent from CI/containers. njoy's leapr::generate::thermal_scattering_law already regenerates the law from a 12 kB checked-in deck.

Scope: add a from_mf7 constructor on thermr::scattering::{IncoherentInelastic,CoherentElastic,IncoherentElastic}Scattering so an already-resolved Mf7 can be consumed without a tape round-trip, then a ThermalScattering::from_leapr(material, temperature, cutoff) on the MC side. Unblocks a light-water thermal test that runs anywhere.
title: outram-mc: build ThermalScattering from a LEAPR-generated law (no external ENDF file)

description:

design:
Child epic of the nuclear refinery programme (bn op-upme).

**Fidelity target: Engineering model**

A distinct catalytic conversion model with a **circulating catalyst inventory**,
which makes it structurally unlike the fixed-bed units.

```
VGO -> FCC riser -> products
                 -> coke on catalyst -> regenerator -> hot catalyst -> riser
```

Catalyst representation should allow at least **Y/USY base catalyst** and
**ZSM-5 additive**. Initial kinetics: a **literature-supported lumped FCC
network**, not full molecular kinetics.

Product resolution must cover: fuel gas; LPG/light olefins; gasoline; LCO;
slurry/heavy oil; coke.

Include catalyst activity/deactivation and coke deposition/regeneration at
appropriate fidelity.

## The regenerator is three things at once

a catalyst-regeneration process; **a heat source**; and **a flue-gas source**.
It must appear in the heat ledger and the flue-gas accounting, not only in the
reactor model.

**Nuclear heat does not eliminate the need to remove catalyst coke.**

## Out of scope for this pass (programme-wide)

Do not: port DWSIM UI or graphical flowsheet objects; port CAPE-OPEN unless a
concrete backend requirement exists; reproduce .NET class architecture; make
DWSIM depend on Outram-FOAM; solve thousands of molecular species in the CDU;
implement molecular reconstruction before assay/pseudocomponent CDU works; call
a converged model validated without reference evidence; hide conservation
errors; push to `main`.
title: Refinery: FCC with USY/ZSM-5
